title: The Devils
author: Joe Abercrombie
summary: A standalone fantasy from Joe Abercrombie in which a mismatched crew of outcasts and misfits is thrown together for a dangerous errand. Expect his usual bleak humour and sudden brutality.
readIf: you like fantasy full of sarcastic, flawed people who bicker while the situation gets worse.
skipIf: you prefer noble heroes and clean victories, or you dislike graphic violence and crude language.

pairings.reason: Abercrombie's own series opener, with the same sour humour and morally murky cast.
Another fantasy about quick-tongued crooks and loyalty among thieves, with a similar mix of jokes and bloodshed.
A grim, soldier's-eye fantasy about a hardened band of mercenaries who are not on the side of the angels.
